rows.text: Adjusted Net Income (as defined below) for the quarter is $39.6 million and excludes $5.3 million of “Total Charges and Credits impacting Adjusted Net Income and Adjusted Diluted EPS,” primarily attributable to a $2.9 million impairment recognized during the third quarter of 2026 related to an investment accounted for under the measurement alternative prescribed by Accounting Standards Codification 321, Investments—Equity Securities , and $1.1 million of current expected credit loss provisions.
